summary: Machine-readable carryforward obligation matrix reconciling incomplete live acceptance, post-deploy observation windows, human authorities, active execution lanes, and orphan PR dispositions.
principles: Code delivery, live runtime verification, and human authority sign-off are distinct states; an archived engineering done does not imply live done.
Pre-production gates must not circularly depend on post-production observation windows.
NFR observation windows (24h, 7 business days, 1 full calendar month) must be bound to their respective post-deployment stages without fake numbers.
Historical completed tasks (source evidence) must be cleanly separated from active canonical execution lanes.
Release gate registry and manifest remain the sole canonical release truth.

Every obligation sits in exactly one stage: pre_production_admission, production_cutover, post_deploy_observation, dev_runtime_observation, code_remediation or deferred; admission never needs a production deployment.
A missing owner is recorded as OWNER_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED with the proposed lane and the action its owner/reviewer must take, never as a settled binding.
